content_metadata.description: A step-by-step instructional video on how to use a pellet press to form benzoic acid pellets, created by the Harper College Chemistry Club.

qAndA.answer: The side with the beveled edge.
qAndA.question: Which side of tube number one should be placed face down in the pellet press?

qAndA.answer: Flip tube number one around so that the flat edge is on the bottom and press the lever again.
